correctness.rationale: For n≥2 and all k the trace depends only on C=(M+M^T)/2. Takagi congruence, finite-rank projection weights and the rearrangement bound give the sharp upper radius. Constructive zero frames cover k=1, all even k and odd k≥3, including full rank, zero and repeated singular values. Path connectedness plus common-phase invariance fill the disk. Difference of successive partial sums proves inverse exactly. Random finite checks corroborate, not certify, the general proof.

value.rationale: This is a complete spectral profile of a recently introduced normalized invariant, not an arbitrarily chosen subcase. All ranks together distinguish hidden Takagi singular spectra having identical ordinary rank-one disks, yielding an exact reconstructibility theorem and a sharp statement of unobservable skew-symmetric degrees of freedom. The full-rank centered disk contrasts meaningfully with the complex-linear top-rank singleton. The explicit zero-frame construction is necessary at finite rank. No general or downstream theorem is claimed.
